title: Project judging
sign-in-required: Sign in with the email address on the judge roster to load your assignments.
offline-unavailable: Judging is not available offline on this device yet. Connect and open this page once to prepare it.
shared-device: This browser stores your assignments and unsynced judging work for offline use. Clear offline data before handing a shared device to someone else.

sync.offline: Offline — {{count}} changes are saved only on this device
sync.locked: Sync is blocked because judging is locked
sync.discarded: Some local work was removed because you are no longer assigned to it
sync.outdated: Your assignments changed before this ranking synced. Review the latest scoring list, then rank again.
sync.updated: Updated from your newer work on another device

cgi-main-track-notice: CGI judges are evaluating this project outside Tracker. You are seeing it only because you are assigned to one of its mini or sponsor challenges. Do not evaluate it for the General or Civic main track.
eligibility-resolved-eligible: Organisers resolved this project as eligible. Add a score to complete this assessment.
note-required: A note is required for unsure or ineligible entries.
rules-concern: Report a rules concern to organisers
recusal-project-help: This applies to the entire team visit, including every challenge assigned to you. Eligible replacement judges are assigned automatically after synchronization.
ranking-gate-help: Connect to verify that your project list is current and synchronize every saved score before leaving the scoring step.
ranking-gate-checking: Synchronizing scores and checking the latest assignments…
ranking-gate-offline: Connect to the internet before continuing to ranking.
ranking-gate-failed: We could not verify the latest assignments. Check your connection and try again.
ranking-gate-incomplete: Your assignments changed or some work is incomplete. Review the scoring step before trying again.
rank-help: Order from weakest at the top to strongest at the bottom.
ready-local: Ready on this device — not yet submitted
ranking-stale: A related score or eligibility decision changed. Review and adjust this ranking to submit it again.
complete: All assigned judging is complete and synchronized.
